title: mysort with options
summary: sort(1) on standard input: -r reverse, -n numeric, -u unique, alone or clustered (-rn).
hints: Keep every line in a growing array of `char *` and sort it with `qsort`. The options are global variables read by the comparison function.
Numeric order: compare `strtol(a, NULL, 10)` of both lines, and if equal compare the lines with `strcmp`. `-r` negates the final result. For each argument loop over its letters after the `-`.
